firm_data.firm_description: Chaves Perlowitz Luftig LLP is a law firm specializing in a diverse range of real estate and financial services, offering expert legal guidance in areas such as residential and commercial buying and selling, banking and lending, commercial leasing, and estate planning.
notable_facts: The firm has offices in Manhattan and Hackensack, NJ.
The firm utilizes advanced technologies to streamline processes and enhance client communication

tech_contact.name: Edward Pierce
tech_contact.title: Chief Administrative Officer ( CAO) & Chief Financial Officer

email.to_title: Chief Administrative Officer & Chief Financial Officer
email.subject: AI for Chaves Perlowitz Luftig LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Edward,

Chaves Perlowitz Luftig has built something impressive since 1997: a real estate and lending practice that competes on expertise, not scale. That's exactly the model we're built to support.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters to practices like yours: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how ex-lawyers like us are helping firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
